desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Dungeon Incremental! ⛏️

Buy your way deeper into an endless dungeon. Every chunk you open makes you richer, and every biome hides a boss waiting at the end.

How deep can you go? 🕳️

How to play:
💰 Buy dungeon chunks and earn money every second
⛏️ Mine ores, smelt bars and automate everything
🍀 Roll Runes, Auras, Titles and Cubes (up to 1 in 5,000,000!)
🎣 Fish for Pearls in the Sunken Temple
🌳 Grow a huge Upgrade Tree
👑 Defeat 5 bosses: Skeleton King, Iron Golem, Golden Pharaoh, Leviathan and the Fire Demon
🔥 Rebirth for massive multipliers and reach the Molten Core

🎁 Free Rewards (lobby board):
👥 Join the Group: +15% Cash
👍 Like the game: +10% Cash
⏰ Play for 30 minutes: +10% Cash
💬 Join our Community Server for a secret code: x1.2 Luck forever!

⭐ Favorite the game so you don't miss new biomes and updates!
